about: ERG workout (VO2 5x4) with the rider changing effort, turning ERG off and on, skipping, the cadence guard, a manual pause, an auto pause and a lap

workout.name: VO2max 5 x 4 min (110%)
workout.description: 5 x 4 min at 110% FTP with equal recovery, cadence 95+. The last minute of each rep should feel like you could hold it 60 more seconds, not 3 minutes.

messages.text: VO2 day: 5 x 4 min at 110% FTP.
The goal is time near max oxygen, not max watts.
Cadence 95+ on the reps. High cadence spares your legs.
Last minute of each rep: hard, but you could do 60 s more.
Opener next: 1 minute near threshold.
Wake the legs up. {watts} W.
Easy now. Get your breath back.
Rep 1 in 20 seconds. Spin up to 95.
Rep 1. Settle in, don't spike the start.
Rep {rep} of {of}. {watts} W.
Last rep. {watts} W. Make it count.
Breathe deep and rhythmic. Relax your shoulders.
Halfway. Keep the cadence above 95.
One minute. This is where it counts.
Last minute of the last rep. Everything you have.
15 seconds. Hold it.
Finish it!
Easy. Drop the cadence, breathe.
Next rep in 20 seconds. {left} to go.
All 5 reps done. Nice work.
Cool-down. Easy spin, then save the ride.
